SCIA1.label: Institution Admin / Support

SCIA1.1.label: Organisation / Affiliation Profile Data
SCIA1.1.description: Definition: The institution's affiliation/organisation profile data in Scopus is missing, incorrect or needs updating.

SCIA1.2.label: IP / Entitlement Maintenance
SCIA1.2.description: Definition: Routine maintenance of the institution's IP ranges, entitlements or link-resolver settings is needed.

SCIA1.3.label: Admin Console / Role Setup
SCIA1.3.description: Definition: Institution administrators need admin console access, roles or configuration.

SCIA1.4.label: Usage Reports / Statistics
SCIA1.4.description: Definition: The institution needs usage data or reports.

SCIA1.5.label: Logo / Branding Update
SCIA1.5.description: Definition: The institution wants its logo or branding updated in Scopus.

SCIA1.6.label: SSO / SAML Configuration
SCIA1.6.description: Definition: The institution's federated/SSO set-up needs configuration.

SCIA1.7.label: Training / Onboarding
SCIA1.7.description: Definition: The institution requests training or onboarding sessions.

SCIA1.8.label: Link Resolver / OpenURL Setup
SCIA1.8.description: Definition: The institution needs its link resolver / OpenURL set up or corrected.

SCIA1.9.label: Scopus AI Feature Control / User Management
SCIA1.9.description: Definition: The institution administrator asks how to turn Scopus AI features on or off or manage AI users.

SCIA1.10.label: Unknown / Not Stated
SCIA1.10.description: Definition: The cause of the institutional request is not stated.

SCIA1.description: Every ticket in this task has already been classified at Level 1 as 'Institution Admin / Support'. Choose the Level 2 value from this group only. 'Institution Admin / Support' means: Definition: Institution-level items that are not access blockers: admin console/roles, SSO/SAML setup, organisation/affiliation profile data, IP/entitlement maintenance, link resolver, usage reports, logo/branding, training/onboarding.
